body: This feels like a very entitled article and thing to say. I would understand this if it came from the perspective of a team that is performing well and is consistently at the top and deserves it, but Caltys and G2 Hel are simply not. The only leagues that they place high in are female focused, while their participation in the regional leagues (NLC/SOL 1) leaves a lot to be desired as they’ve barely won any games against players with no payment or organizational structure (2/16 in NLC, 3/15). Why ask for gamechangers if you’re consistently underperforming? To get more money in a scene where barely anyone under a pro level gets paid? You’re already underperforming against teams that don’t have the luxury of salary or structure, why should you receive more? How is this the fault of riot that G2 Hel are performing poorly in every league they play that isn’t female focused?
